name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx as a multi-site web server for three configured cluster-local virtual hosts, including site roots, static landing pages, TLS configuration, and service lifecycle. It also applies related security controls such as Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, creates Redis logging storage, and configures a Redis server on port 6379, including authentication and service-related settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs a Python/PostgreSQL runtime, checks out a FastAPI tutorial application, creates a virtual environment, installs requirements, provisions a PostgreSQL database and user, and runs the application under systemd.
